policy: Recommendations only. Print install commands only when install_command is present or supplied by an override manifest.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.when: Any project with git, branches, commits, landing, rebasing, or release work.
skills.notes: Core workflow discipline for orchestrated work.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.when: Project onboarding, adapter docs, root navigators, or context-window hygiene.
skills.notes: Useful with AGENTS.md and lazy-loaded docs.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.when: A feature needs ordered implementation tasks, estimates, or parallelization.
skills.notes: Pairs with SLICES.md.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.when: Architectural decisions, public APIs, shipping features, or durable project docs are involved.
skills.notes: Pairs with DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.when: Before merging or landing non-trivial changes.
skills.notes: Good final gate before all-or-hold landing.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.when: Implementing behavior, fixing bugs, or proving changes with regression tests.
skills.notes: Use where behavior can be specified with tests.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.when: Frontend, mobile UI, layout, components, interactions, copy, or production-quality product surfaces.
skills.notes: Use for visible UI work.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.when: Browser runtime QA, DOM inspection, console/network debugging, visual checks, or performance traces.
skills.notes: Requires a compatible browser/devtools connector.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.when: Load time, Core Web Vitals, expensive renders, backend latency, or resource use matters.
skills.notes: Useful after a measurable performance target exists.

skills.name: prototype
skills.when: A design, state machine, or interaction needs to be tried before committing.
skills.notes: Good for exploratory UI choices.

skills.name: vocabulary
skills.when: Precise UI, design, accessibility, or copy terminology would improve specs and reviews.
skills.notes: Complements GLOSSARY.md without replacing domain terms.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.when: REST, GraphQL, public module boundaries, schemas, contracts, SDKs, or frontend/backend interfaces change.
skills.notes: Use before locking API shapes.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.when: Auth, sessions, external integrations, file uploads, secrets, user input, or data boundaries are involved.
skills.notes: Pairs with glossary privacy/security boundaries.

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.when: Framework/library behavior must be checked against official docs.
skills.notes: Useful when technology choices may have drifted.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.when: Tests, builds, runtime behavior, or deploys fail unexpectedly.
skills.notes: Use for root-cause debugging.

skills.name: diagnose
skills.when: A hard bug or performance regression needs reproduce, minimize, instrument, fix, and regression-test.
skills.notes: Stronger loop for difficult failures.

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.when: CI, checks, deployment pipelines, release automation, or quality gates change.
skills.notes: Pairs with DEPLOY.md and QA.md.

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.when: Preparing a production launch, rollout, rollback, monitoring, or release checklist.
skills.notes: Use for launch readiness.

skills.name: github
skills.when: GitHub PRs, issues, stacked branches, repository automation, or gh CLI workflows are involved.
skills.notes: Useful when the project uses GitHub.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.when: A feature touches multiple files or needs staged landing.
skills.notes: Good companion for vertical slices.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.when: A feature or project lacks a clear specification.
skills.notes: Use before implementation when requirements are fuzzy.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.when: An idea needs expansion, critique, or convergence before becoming a slice.
skills.notes: Use before SLICES.md hardens a fuzzy concept.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.when: User intent is underspecified and product success criteria are unclear.
skills.notes: Use for intent discovery.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.when: A plan needs stress-testing against domain language and docs.
skills.notes: Useful before accepting glossary or slice decisions.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.when: A non-trivial decision deserves adversarial review before standing.
skills.notes: Use for high-stakes or hard-to-reverse choices.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.when: The project needs architectural cleanup, consolidation, or better AI navigability.
skills.notes: Use after glossary and repo topology are known.

skills.name: triage
skills.when: Incoming bugs, feature requests, or issue queues need classification.
skills.notes: Useful for support or issue intake.

skills.name: to-prd
skills.when: Conversation context should become a product requirements document.
skills.notes: Use after product intent stabilizes.

skills.name: to-issues
skills.when: A plan or PRD should become independently grabbable implementation issues.
skills.notes: Use after slices and gates are reviewed.

skills.name: handoff
skills.when: Work crosses a thread, owner, review, QA, deploy, or context boundary.
skills.notes: Recommend when state must be preserved for another agent or later session.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.when: A user wants to discover whether a skill exists for a capability.
skills.notes: Useful for expanding a team's skill catalog.
